posts.title: An SBOM Is Not a Deployment Map
bullets: Inventory components and versions for each release.
Link every release to deployed services and owners.
When a CVE appears, find exposed systems and verify the fix.
posts.takeaway: Connect dependency inventory to real deployments.
posts.caption: An SBOM tells you what's inside a release—not necessarily where that release is running. Link components to deployments and accountable owners. When a vulnerability appears, trace affected systems and verify remediation. #AppSec #SBOM #VulnerabilityManagement #DevSecOps Save this for later.
